name: lot_developer_base_texture
description: SetNormalLotBaseTexture and PickLotBaseTextureForLot (§6.6), file RNG seed 12345. For each configuration object of type 2 in array order the code takes the object position (slot 39), and when the ID list is not empty and its first ID is non-zero draws R4 = Uniform(n) to pick a base, then looks for a wealth/decay variant: hi = base & 0xFFFF0000, and the candidates in order are hi | (((wealth << 4) | decay) << 8), hi | (wealth << 12), hi | (decay << 8); the first instance that exists (resource type 0x7AB50E44 group 0x0986135E) is used, else the base. wealth is the lot's occupant wealth, or the building profile's wealth, else 1; decay is condition 0-1 -> 0, 2-3 -> 1, 4-6 -> 2. forceEmpty with a zone not in {0,11,12,15} routes to SetEmptyLotBaseTexture (no draw). The 0xE99B3D4D condition-changed message re-picks the texture for a lot in state 3 or 4 only. Init is run before any lot exists, so its forced base-texture refresh (§1.3 step 12) walks zero lots and draws nothing.

steps.note: no lots yet, so the forced refresh draws nothing
occupant wealth 0 -> profile wealth 2; condition 0 -> decay 0; hi = 0x2A000000
no variant resource present -> the base pick 0x2A000000
the orientation byte comes from GetPositionForLotConfigurationObject (slot 39), scripted as 0 here; byte3 is the object's byte 3; texture 0x2A000000 is the base pick
occupant wealth 3 used directly; condition 4 -> decay 2; first candidate ((3<<4)|2)<<8 = 0x3200 -> 0x2A003200
only the (decay<<8) = 0x200 candidate exists -> 0x2A000200 (candidates 0x2A003200 and 0x2A003000 are absent)
forceEmpty with a zone not in {0,11,12,15} routes to SetEmptyLotBaseTexture
a fresh instance for an empty draw trace (no Init: Init's forced refresh would itself draw)
the condition-changed message looks the lot up by location, so lot 3 gets its own cell (5,0); it re-picks the texture for a lot in state 3
a lot not in state 3 or 4: no texture work
